Lia (partnerships): Quick idea 1: pilot a compact SI onboarding play ("QuickPlay") next month: 1-day lab + badge + marketplace fast-track. Thoughts?
Omar (solutions): Love it. Keep scope small: core API flows (chat, generate, embeddings) + perf smoke.
Priya (pmkt): Badge sounds good. Can we also promise a short featured slot in the marketplace to incentivize signups?
Zoe (p-success): Operationallywe should cap pilot at 6 SI teams. We'll provide trainer seats and sandbox credits.
Dan (eng): Infra note: need a reproducible test harness and ephemeral GPU nodes. Propose 2 nodes/day per cohort.
Lia (partnerships): OK. Proposed acceptance: automated tests green + one live QA session. Omar, can you draft the test manifest schema?
Omar (solutions): On it. Key fields: model_name, variant, quant, sample_prompts, expected_behavior. I'll add a sample manifest snippet.
Priya (pmkt): I'll draft a short co-marketing kit and a press checklist. Legal review will be needed for quotes.
Zoe (p-success): I'll own scheduling and credits: 1500 credits per SI, expiration 45 days. Also will record the QA session for the playbook.
Dan (eng): I'll prep infra and a dashboard for the QuickPlay week. Need service account name and allowlist IPs from partners.
partners-bot: Created ticket #4999: "QuickPlay SI pilot" and invited Omar, Priya, Zoe, Dan.
Lia (partnerships): Action items: Omar=manifest + harness; Dan=infra; Zoe=cohort ops + recording; Priya=co-marketing assets + legal loop. Aim to run pilot in 3 weeks.
Omar (solutions): I'll share the draft manifest by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (pmkt): Will start badge mockups and email templates.
Lia (partnerships): Thanks team. Locking calendar invites after manifests look good. :rocket:
